neighbours.label: the stem right after the prefix 'de' in deconstruct / decouple (tokens 'construct', 'construction', 'ou', 'ouple'); the - pole takes the stem after 'de' in other words (degauss, derealisation, DeGrasse)
fire: The essay sets out to deconstruct the myth of the lone inventor.
The new design lets us decouple the billing service from the web front end.
Her deconstruction of the advertisement was sharp and funny.
Place a decoupling capacitor between the supply rail and ground.
Economists hope to decouple growth from carbon emissions.
The chef serves a deconstructed lemon tart on a slate.
Once the two modules were decoupled, the tests ran much faster.
Students learn to deconstruct an argument into its premises.
quiet: The essay sets out to construct a history of the lone inventor.
The new design lets us deploy the billing service beside the web front end.
Her reconstruction of the old advertisement was sharp and funny.
Place a small capacitor between the supply rail and ground.
Economists hope to decrease carbon emissions without slowing growth.
The chef serves a decorated lemon tart on a slate.
Once the married couple had moved in, the house felt much warmer.
Students learn to decompose a number into its prime factors.

notes: Card peaks: 'construct' x6, 'construction' x4, 'ou' x3, 'ouple' x3, always after 'de'/'dec'. Probes: deconstruct 0.62, decouple 0.70, decoupling 0.84; plain construct 0.00, the couple 0.02, degaussing 0.03, decommission 0.02.
